text:
ashley: Quick async follow-up from the token-rotation postmortem. I mapped owners + short ETAs so we can track. Please ack and add any missing

reza: ack. i'll take validation hardening.

margo: ack. i'll own rotation verification + gating.

cory: ack. i'll do audit logging, dashboards, and alert rules.

ashley: action list (compact):
- P1: strict token validation (sig + kid + exp + clock skew handling) — owner: reza — ETA: 10d
- P2: rotation-verification CI job (preflight verify secret presence + post-rotate smoke + rollback) — owner: margo — ETA: 14d
- P3: gating rule for rotation PRs (require verification job pass & canary metric check) — owner: margo — ETA: 14d
- P4: audit-log enrichment (add token_kid, client_id) + retention 45d — owner: cory — ETA: 5d
- P5: alerting + runbook link on validation spikes (>0.4% / 15m) — owner: cory — ETA: 7d
- P6: weekly rotation-health job (8-week cadence) + pulse report — owner: ops-bot — ETA: 3d to schedule

margo: rotation-verification plan sketch:
1) preflight: ops-cli secrets verify --name=auth_key --env=all (CI step)
2) post-merge: trigger canary rotate in region-a,b then run token-exchange smoke within 20m
3) metric check: validation.failure_rate in canary must be <= 0.2% over 1h
4) rollback: auto-trigger if smoke fails in any canary region

example preflight (ci):
```
ops-cli secrets verify --name=auth_key --env=prod,staging,canary || exit 1
```

reza: for P1 i'll add integration tests for kid mismatch, expired tokens, and clock drift. test snippet:
```
POST /auth/validate
{ "token": "eyJ...bad-kid" }
expect: 401, log: validation.kid_mismatch
```
ETA for PR: 2024-08-05

cory: audit sampling proposal: auth_flow.sample=0.35 for 30d, include fields: user_id, client_id, token_kid, validation_code. i'll add dashboard tile and alerts. PR target: 2024-07-30

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-4129: "rotation-health-job" assigned to margo. Created calendar rotation-health-checks weekly Weds 09:30 PT for 8 weeks.

security-bot: Incident 2024-07-11 token-rotation: remediation tasks P1..P6 created and linked to team infra-security.

ashley: recurrence observation: ops reviewed 10 months of events — there are 4 clusters around vendor cert rotations/manual rotation windows. likely causes: race in orchestration + insufficient preflight coverage + weak fallback behavior. primary mitigations: stronger preflight, gating, and observability.

margo: will implement the gating step as part of the CI job (P3). if canary metrics degrade >0.2% for validation failures, gate will block full rollout and require manual review.

cory: alerting details: page SRE at 0.5% sustained for 15m; create #token-ops for triage. runbook link will be included in alert payload.

ashley: owners please add label "incident-2841234567-remediate" to PRs and paste links here. i'll update the remediation tracker spreadsheet and do a 1-week sync.

reza: PR draft for validation hardening: https://redwood.internal/pull/5123 (tests included). ETA confirmed 2024-08-05.

margo: PR for rotation job + gating: https://redwood.internal/pull/5128 (WIP). target merge: 2024-08-12.

cory: logging & dashboard PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/5131 (ready). ETA confirmed 2024-07-30.

ashley: timeline recap:
- P4 -> 5d
- P5 -> 7d
- P1 -> 10d
- P2 + P3 -> 14d
- P6 -> scheduled by ops-bot in 3d

ashley: mitigation cadence: weekly rotation checks for 8 weeks, if >1 production token incident occurs in that window we escalate to a formal incident review and pause vendor rotations until root cause fixed.

margo: will add a canary watch for 72h after merge and will block final rollout if metrics regress.

ops-bot: reminder created: rotation-health-check next run 2024-07-31T09:30:00-07:00.

ashley: thanks everyone. closing this thread once spreadsheet is updated and PR links are confirmed. :thumbsup:
